worldcombat.skill.vinewhip.summary: The vines snap taut and flick a narrow line at the target — the fastest, cheapest and lightest strike of its family. It barely telegraphs and can be flicked again and again, winning through rhythm and numbers; the double form lands two flicks in one action.
worldcombat.skill.vinewhip.use.0: A quick, cheap strike at close range
worldcombat.skill.vinewhip.use.1: Land a second flick before the foe can step aside
worldcombat.skill.vinewhip.use.2: Answer a foe attacking you with a quick flick
worldcombat.skill.vinewhip.description.0: A narrow line is flicked at the target, dealing about %1$s contact damage to each non-ally caught in it; it reaches %2$s blocks and covers %3$s blocks to each side of the line, and one flick hits at most 2 enemies, each only once.
worldcombat.skill.vinewhip.description.1: One action flicks %1$s times, %2$s seconds apart in the double form; the same target can be caught by both flicks.
worldcombat.skill.vinewhip.double.on: Double form: two quick flicks in one action — slightly more total damage and easier to land the second, but a longer recovery and cooldown and a lighter single hit.
worldcombat.skill.vinewhip.double.off: Single form: one crisper, heavier flick with a shorter recovery.
worldcombat.skill.vinewhip.timing: Reach within %1$s blocks; after %2$s seconds of preparation it costs %4$s PP, then %3$s seconds of recovery and a %5$s second cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.vinewhip.growth.0: At level %1$s, the lash power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.vinewhip.growth.1: At level %1$s, the lash power rises to %2$s and the reach to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.vinewhip.preference.do: On: two quick flicks in one action (slightly more total damage, easier to land a second before the foe steps aside), but a longer recovery and cooldown and a lighter single hit. Off (single): one crisper, heavier flick with a shorter recovery.
worldcombat.skill.vinewhip.preference.ai: It will not open with Vine Whip beyond this distance; it closes in first. This is a close flick, so a larger value mostly invites whiffs while chasing.
On: targets currently attacking it rank higher; off: it only ranks by threat and distance. This is a quick flick that answers an attacker, not an interrupt of their action.
On: prefer this flick when the target is below three tenths health. Off: it only competes as an ordinary melee option.
